hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */agents/mcp.json) r=${f%/agents/mcp.json}; node "$r/terminal/claude/mcp.ts" && node "$r/terminal/opencode/mcp.ts" ;; esac

[ -e "$HOME/.claude/CLAUDE.md" ] && [ -e "$HOME/.claude/skills/github/SKILL.md" ] || echo "Setup links are stale: run sh ${DOTFILES_PATH:-<setup checkout>}/agents/install.sh && sh ${DOTFILES_PATH:-<setup checkout>}/terminal/claude/install.sh, then restart Claude Code."

if [ -n "${HOME-}" ] && [ -f "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh" ] && [ -r "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh" ] && [ -x "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh" ]; then ORCA_HOOK_AGENT_PID="${PPID:-}"; export ORCA_HOOK_AGENT_PID; /bin/sh "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh"; else { command -p cat 2>/dev/null || cat; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; fi
